reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of working with Ace Screen & Repair, and I can’t recommend them highly enough! From start to finish, the experience was nothing short of excellent. A special shout out to Donna M, our wonderful sales representative who was incredibly helpful and very responsive. She made the entire process smooth and easy, answering all of our questions and getting our project off the ground without delay. Donna’s professionalism and attention to our needs have us great confidence in choosing Ace Screen & Repair.

As for the installation, Petey was outstanding! He worked efficiently, and completed the job as exactly promised. Petey was courteous, respectful of our property, and made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly after the job was complete. Ace Screen & Repair not only provided a very reasonable quote compared to other companies we looked into, but their professionalism, communication, and quality of work truly set them apart. If you’re considering screen repair or installation don’t hesitate to go with Ace Screen & Repair. You’ll be glad you did!

Christine S
reviews.author: Christine Stengel

reviews.text: We hired Ace Screen to build a lanai screened in enclosure on the back of our house. Our experience with this company was superb. From the communication with the office to the workers on-site we were impressed! We also had a good laugh when one of the workers (female) was losing her nail and my husband helped her glue it back on. I would recommend this company to everyone.
reviews.author: Sharon Perry

reviews.text:
Wow, wow, wow!  We could not be happier.  Immediately after buying our house, we contacted 4 companies that friends and our realtor recommended for designing and installing a cage in place of the existing fence.  While keeping bugs out was important, our primary reason for the cage was to keep out poisonous toads and snakes in order to protect our two dogs.  While Ace was not the least expensive of the four companies, after checking references and going on our gut feeling about the rep from each company we met, we went with Ace.  The price was very fair and within our budget and the references with whom we spoke loved Ace.  Now, we do too.

The start of the work was delayed due to a change we had to make in the footprint due to our HOA.  But once the work began it was completed quickly, professionally and with a lot of attention to detail.  And I mean a lot.  The team of 3 guys worked hard to get the cage up quickly but without taking any shortcuts.  They were very considerate, making sure at the end of each day that tools and materials were not left in the way.  We also just found them to be nice guys.

The most important reason for the 5-star rating is the end result.  The cage is sturdy, properly finished and although pool cages are never a thing of beauty, we think ours looks really good.  We added a footer to our layout so that we could have a grass area inside the cage for the dogs.  We absolutely love the fact we can leave the sliders open on nicer days and the dogs can roam in and out with no worry about critters that can hurt them or worse.

I are very glad to have hired Ace and would use them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Richard Gans

reviews.text: After having our lania replaced we decided to enclose the front entrance of our home. From Chad doing our estimate to Jarron installing our entry way screening it was a very nice process. We spoke with Donna in the office and we were surprised when they called and said they could install the enclosure on Friday. The installation took about three hours to complete. Ace Screen Repair and More is our go to company for screen work. THank you very much Ace Screen Repair LLC for a quality job well done. We will be referring others who ask about screenrooms, pool cages and such to Ace Screen Repair to get estimates and have work done.
reviews.author: Glenn C Gerber

reviews.text: From my first meeting with Donna, the sales rep, to conversations with Angie, things couldn't have been easier.  The installers did excellent work with meticulous attention to detail when installing my gutters and doors.  The service department is exceptional as well.  I highly recommend Ace!
reviews.author: P J

reviews.text: ACE screened my front entry that had arches and stone pillars requiring tedious cutting to get a tight and nice looking seal. Waited through a storm in order to complete job same day. Very happy with results and highly recommend. Competitive price and great quality.
reviews.author: James Fiacco

reviews.text: Dre and Michael did a fantastic job installing my new gutters! The craftsmen were professional, efficient, and detail-oriented from start to finish. Everything looks clean and secure. They left the area spotless and made sure I was happy with the result before driving off. Highly recommend their work!
reviews.author: OAL

reviews.text: We are so pleased with the work done by Ace Screen Repair. From our initial phone call, to completion, their professionalism showed. Christi was wonderful in answering all my questions when she came out for the estimate. Jaaron and Dave were precise and did a marvelous job. Angie was extremely pleasant on the phone. I highly recommend Ace Screen Repair. We had all the screens replaced and it looks great.
reviews.author: Barbara Picardi

reviews.text: My experience with ACE was very good.  Steve really did an awesome job with the inspection process, TBH I had 6 other companies come out and provide quotes and all of them were either way to high or just a plain rip off.  I will say the only reason I didnt give ACE a 5 star rating was I did have to wait two weeks to finally get on the schedule however, once I was scheduled they came out the next day.  The guy who did the work was good work quickly and made sure that he walked the area before starting.  I will use ACE for any screen repairs or needs I may have in the future.  THANK YOU ACE!
reviews.author: Brent Masmann

reviews.text:
We have used Ace screen repair on two different occasions. We have a new Home less than four years old and every time we would get a heavy rain, the gutters and the lanai area and pool would overflow. Ace screen came out and determined that the opening in the gutters where it flows into the downspouts had not been cut to the proper size, it was too small. They also suggested that the amount of roof area the gutters and downspouts were serving that the downspouts needed to be increased in size. They increase the opening size in the gutters and installed larger downspouts. In the past few years, we have had several heavy rains and we have had no problem in our lanai area.
A few weeks ago, we noticed that the base plate at the bottom of our picture window screen had come loose. We call Ace screening they came out and evaluated and advised us that the screws that hold it in place had rusted out. They were very concerned that we could lose the complete screen if the plate was not re-anchored immediately. They rearranged their schedule to accommodate us and completed the necessary repair. They saved the screen.
We have found this company to be very knowledgeable, timely and competitive. Should the need arise in the future we will definitely use Ace screening repair.
reviews.author: Kenneth Woods

reviews.text:
After Hurricane Milton, it was difficult finding a reliable and honest pool cage company.
We were lucky enough to have found Ace. We live in Sarasota and they are based in Fort Myers.
We had our cage area measured, got a quote within a couple days and signed a contract with them.  The quote we received was extremely fair, especially after the hurricane. Some other quotes we received from other vendors were ridiculous.
They took care of all the permitting and when they built our cage, they did a fantastic job.  Our neighbor watched the guys build our cage. When they finished the neighbor came by and said that our cage is built so well and it looks great (even better than his).  I agree.

Ariana who coordinated all the permitting and scheduling is top notch.  Ariana communication with us was excellent. We always knew where we were in the process of permitting, scheduling  and post completion.

If you want a great pool cage company, you should contact them. They will do a great job for you.
reviews.author: Sam Hong

reviews.text:
ACE was subcontractor through my pool builder. I was extremely disappointed by the length of time it took for the pool screen to be installed. My pool was built in 4 weeks but it took 3 additional weeks for ACE to put up my screen. Most disappointing, the ran out of caulk and failed to install a ground wire on the day of install, further delaying my permit approval. They had to come back, and still failed to finish caulking.

Even worse, I reached out to them immediately afterwords requesting a quote for a dog door install in which they failed to send me in a timely manor (sent to wrong email), and have not followed up with me per additional questions I had.

I gave two stars because although it took 3 weeks to install, the crew they sent built my entire pool screen in 1 day. It was very impressive. The crew was great!
reviews.author: Jon Hansen

reviews.text: Working with Christi was great! We received the quote quickly and were able to get the job scheduled as soon as we had HOA approval! Our installer, Jaaron was at very hard worker, knew how to get the job done and was very polite! We highly recommend Ace Screen repair & More!

reviews.text: Just had our gutters and downspouts replaced.  The crew did a wonderful job with the installation.  They were very professional, polite and answered my questions.  They also replaced our lanai cage and installed our screened entranceway.  Always dependable.

reviews.text: Hello. My interaction with this company was professional and comfortable. From Christi for an estimate, Angie scheduling and to Pete coming out to install new deck bolts and rescreening. Pete left my lanai looking wonderfully improved. (And not a scrap or bolt to pick up!) Great team. Thank you!

reviews.text: I would not recommend this company. The workmanship is shoddy at best. They left a mess on my property that I had to clean up. The screen was not cut evenly, one of the bottom panels was not seated well and came loose along the edge. They also did not provide screened panels along the bottom of my deck above as promised. There was an area of 6 inches by 3 feet in my lanai area that wasn't even screened. There were cigarette butts all around my pool area. I am just hoping the next hurricane doesn't blow it over like it did during Milton. (built by same company)

reviews.text: Our pool builder contracted Ace to tear down and rebuild our new cage around our lanai and new pool. Justin and his team were great to work with! We had a couple of areas that needed to be adjusted and Justin communicated with us very well and took care of the issues promptly. I would highly recommend Ace to anybody looking for a new cage.
reviews.author: Jason Krapf

reviews.text: Unfortunately this company doesn't disclose processing fees until after the work is agreed to and completed, even though it is a law to do so. Every invoice I've received ( even from my pool service co) clearly states this when paying cash vs. CC prior to,  and how much the price will change. ACE Screen would rather continue lengthly disputes via e-mail , then simply do right to a customer that could be giving them future business. They also never called to schedule the work after being paid for the initial payment via CC with again no mention the price would change. After a week, I had I call to find out when they would start on my screens. With so many options in FL for this work- I will now recommend to anyone asking in Real Estate to choose someone other ACE Screens.
reviews.author: Cassie Bee

reviews.text: They gave us the best price for rescreening our lanai screens(out of 3 quotes) with 20/20 no see um super screens. Pete came and did it all by himself. He cleaned everything up. They are being so helpful as we had one panel he could not do, our hurricane shutter won't go up all the way. He will come back once the hurricane shutter is fixed.

reviews.text:
Update:
01/29/25-Today a technician responded and performed a more in-depth repair removing excess amounts of caulk from the last several repairs. He also removed the seam plate, cleaned everything off and then reinstalled everything including some stripped out screws. The end result looks much better than the previous repairs and we are hopeful this has solved the issues. Today’s tech acknowledged the previous attempts were at best substandard. I have added a star pending the next rainfall.

Had them out in Feb. 2024 due to pool cage shift during hurricane Ian.  Gave a detailed explanation for what needed to be done in several areas.  Control arms on 2 screen doors were replaced, tension cables adjusted and gutter issues were "fixed" fpr just under $900.  After several delays and 2 additional vists the leaks persist.  I called and left voice mails and was ghosted.  Photos below were  on 01/19/2025. The gutter "repair" seemed to consist of putting large amounts of caulk on the seam instead of reinstalling it to original condition.

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The 5-star reviews contain highly specific, credible details about projects and personnel. The 1-2 star complaints are also specific and describe realistic post-installation service issues, not fake-sounding grievances. The volume and consistency point to a legitimate, quality contractor with some operational growing pains in customer service follow-up.
authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details (lanai enclosures, gutters, pool cages)
Mention of numerous employee names (Donna, Chad, Jarron, Angie, Christi, Dre, Michael, Steve, Juan)
Mix of detailed praise and specific, credible complaints
References to real-world events (Hurricane Milton, permitting)
complaint_patterns: Incomplete or substandard work requiring follow-up
